literal: The faultless bountiful yield will diminish of the land that bore the body without fame.
translation: The rich, faultless yield of the earth will diminish if it must bear the burden of bodies that have achieved no fame.
modern: புகழ் இல்லாத உடம்பைத் தாங்கிய நிலத்தின் குற்றமில்லாத வளமான விளைச்சல் குறைந்துபோகும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the burden that people who live without earning fame place upon the earth. The poet states that the otherwise faultless and highly fertile land (வண்பயன்) will see its natural abundance diminish (குன்றும்) when it is forced to support the physical bodies (யாக்கை) of those who lack renown (இசையிலா). By linking the earth's fertility to the worthiness of its inhabitants, the verse poetically emphasizes that a life lived without leaving a good name is a drain on the world's resources.
